property.content: Welcome to XWiki! This tour shows you the basics. You start by creating your own tutorial page in the Sandbox.
Click Create to add a new page.
This is the title of your new page. Type one that includes your name, for example "Tutorial page of Alice", then click Next.
This is the editor. You can change the content now or later. Click Done to save your page.
Congratulations, you created your tutorial page! The next tasks happen on this page.
